question: As per the BS standards, the Environment Management code is:
solution:
__**Explanation:**__

**Environment Management Code as per BS Standards**

 
• The Environment Management Code, as per the British Standards (BS), is denoted by **BS EN ISO 14001**. This standard provides the framework for environmental management systems (EMS) in organizations, enabling them to minimize their environmental footprint, comply with applicable regulations, and continuously improve their environmental performance. It is widely recognized across industries and sectors for its effectiveness in promoting sustainability and environmental responsibility.
 
• The BS EN ISO 14001 standard focuses on a structured approach to managing environmental aspects and impacts. It follows the Plan-Do-Check-Act (PDCA) cycle, ensuring systematic planning, implementation, monitoring, and improvement of environmental management practices. Organizations adopting this standard commit to:
 
• Identifying and addressing environmental aspects and impacts associated with their activities, products, or services.
 
• Complying with legal and regulatory requirements related to the environment.
